notes: Text version of the nightly steps. Same model, endpoint and pinned provider as config/openrouter.json; no images are sent.
Thinking is on only for reflector_text, as for the paper reflector. moments, marking and matching run without thinking.
matching is for scoring only (experiment ②): it matches trigger candidates to answer-key events and is never a model input.

predictor_text is for scoring only (experiment ②, day scoring): the paper predictor reading record lines. It keeps the paper predictor settings (temperature 0.3, no thinking) and the paper predictor output cap of config/openrouter.json (2048).
The 600-second timeout and the output-token caps are caller safeguards, not paper settings. A truncated answer is rejected, not repaired.

moments was 16384 until 2026-11-16. One hour of a busy record reached 10889 output tokens on day 1 and was cut off at 16384 on day 2 (the record itself was wrong then and was fixed); 32768 leaves room for a dense hour such as dinner. The pinned provider allows 65536.
